{{Quote|Fortunately, title in this place came to me years ago, after he moved out. If I have to, I can sell it, get a less expensive place, live on the difference. But I'd hate to do that. I love this place.|Zehrinne Thaal|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Zehrinne Thaal's apartment''' was located in the [[Cloud Paradise]] building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Garik Loran]], leader of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, visited [[Zehrinne Thaal]] there to discuss her ex-husband, [[Galactic Alliance Army|Galactic Alliance Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. During their conversation, Zehrinne revealed that Stavin had given her the apartment's title after moving out.<ref name="MK" />
